acceptanceCriteria: Receipt retention is bounded (last N per member/operation) or moved out of pools.json, with a test at 256 members.
A full-size pool still accepts acquire/release.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1585 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1104, head 2215d54aa, PSR-V0-160..167); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1585-pool-member-lifecycle.md. GitHub #1028 stays open for these. Expected: operation receipts are bounded or compacted so a full pool cannot wedge pool writes. Actual: retained receipts grow pools.json toward 1 MiB; writes then refuse LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
